notes: Author page 9; archive folio 82, thinner/lighter and in another unnamed archival hand, at lower left. The folio is transcribed and inventoried, but its relation to H’s page marker is excluded from the substantive difference count.

The opening continues an earlier sentence about a torus and a suitable generalized Jacobian. The new paragraph says that for such a variety (examples: an elliptic curve and G_m(C)=C*) the Gamma action on the groupoid is no longer faithful, so invariants attached only to this same X cannot suffice to locate u. It calls for other varieties defined over K and names U_{0,3}=P^1 minus {0,1,infinity}.

A visible separator precedes the final paragraph, which begins varying X and introducing a morphism of K-schemes, written f:X [joining stroke] X. The final on déduit des morphismes de groupoïdes continues beyond this leaf. The target X is retained exactly; no Y is supplied from the expected formulation.
All mathematics was transcribed and the formula shapes compared; no theorem, proof, or algebraic assertion was independently checked. Therefore check_events is empty.

The U alphabet, terminal character of the joining stroke, and correction/deletion status of the lower loop in considérant remain explicit doubts. The lexical word considérant itself is readable; H’s separate canceled illegible word is not supported as a distinct token.

There are no confidently identified separate insertions, deletions, or marginal authorial comments on this leaf. The possible overworking within considérant is recorded as an unresolved state within its text block. The unlabelled horizontal separator is reproduced in TikZ.

Macro-only choices such as l versus ell for the same path label, equation-tag syntax, H’s editorial page note, and spacing of p.ex. are not counted. Literal quotation shape, underlining, added punctuation, and paragraphing are counted.
All judgments in this report are reader_c’s independent readings. Root had not supplied a deciding ink ruling at the time the files were finalized.
